message:
You know, there’s something almost comedic about finding out you’re not prepared for a storm. I once thought I could weather a summer heatwave with nothing but a half-empty lemonade pitcher and a couple of fans. Spoiler alert: I ended up channeling my inner popsicle! 

I stumbled upon this handy resource that’s all about being smart during those heat spells. It’s packed with simple tips that might just save you from becoming a human puddle on the living room floor. 

Have you ever had a not-so-great ‘surprise’ moment when getting ready for a storm? What little tricks do you have up your sleeve for staying cool and collected? ☀️
